description: Full-market real-time quote scan (~5800 A-share securities, ~3 MB unfiltered). Narrow server-side first: `sort` + `order` + `limit` return a real ranking (`sort=pct_change, order=desc, limit=50` = the day's 50 strongest in a few KB); `limit` without `sort` is an alphabetical sample, not a ranking. When rows are dropped the response carries `truncated: true` and `matched_total` (the pre-limit count) — `total` is only how many rows came back. The universe includes ETFs (`security_type` on every row); money-market ETFs dominate `sort=amount`, so pass `security_type=stock` for a stock-only board (filtered before sort/limit). `include_margin` attaches the T+1 margin block; `include_industry` attaches `industry` (Shenwan L1/L2) and `top_concept`. Both are often absent — coverage, not failure: `top_concept` resolves for only a subset of A-shares and `industry` does not cover `BSE:*`; `top_concept` is not the limit-up LLM `leading_concept`, which is not served here. Live rows also expose `top_base_concept` `{id,name,kind:base,pct_change}` and `top_concept_status` / `top_base_concept_status` (ready, no_membership, no_snapshot, unavailable). The two layers rank independently; use kind=base for base detail. Historical rows carry neither current theme field nor their statuses. **In `pre_open` / `auction` sessions read each row's `auction` block, not top-level `price` / `pct_change`** (same rules as `quote`: only `auction.status = matched` with `auction.pct_change = 0` is a flat auction; compute from `auction.prev_close`). Read `market_trade_date`, not `snapshot_at`, to decide whether a row is today's — a frozen feed keeps `snapshot_at` moving. `is_margin_target` is margin-list membership (T+1), not activity; the key is absent (never `false`) when the list cannot be loaded. `trade_date=YYYY-MM-DD` scans that past day's daily bars (see the parameter for allowed combinations). 竞价未匹配量 unmatched 为股，正买负卖；unmatched_as_of 是最后有效竞价观测的源时间（09:25 后冻结），历史未采集为 null。

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

concept_id.description: Restrict the scan to one concept's / industry's members. Applied **before** sort and limit, so `concept_id` + `sort=pct_change` + `limit=10` gives the top 10 movers **inside that concept** (and `matched_total` counts its members, not the whole market). An unknown / inactive / wrong-dimension id returns 404, so an empty result means the theme has no members in today's snapshot rather than a bad id. Get ids from `concepts_list` or `concepts_of`.

concept_kind.description: Dimension of `concept_id`: concept (hot-theme library, default), base (base labels), or industry (Shenwan). Ignored alone.

include.description: `active` (default) drops ST / delisted / stale rows; `all` keeps them, flagged with `stale: true` and `stale_since`.

include_industry.description: Attach `industry` (Shenwan L1/L2 `{l1:{id,name}, l2:{id,name}}`) and `top_concept` (`{id,name,pct_change}`, highest-moving member concept now; not the limit-up `leading_concept`). Also attaches `top_base_concept` (kind=base) and separate availability statuses for both layers. Off by default (payload). Ids feed the concepts endpoints (`kind=industry` / `kind=concept`).

include_margin.description: Attach the T+1 margin block (off by default, ~25% larger). `as_of` is normally the previous trading day; judge direction by `financing_net_buy_cny` (`financing_buy_cny` is gross); null = not published, not zero.

limit.description: Keep the first N rows **after** sorting (1-10000). Always pair with `sort` — an unsorted limit is an alphabetical sample. When rows are dropped: `truncated: true` + `matched_total` (pre-limit count); `total` is only the returned count.

margin_target.description: Keep only margin-eligible securities (true) or only non-eligible (false); omit for both. Returns 503 if the list cannot be loaded.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to `desc` for numeric keys and `asc` for `canonical_code`. Ignored without `sort`.

security_type.description: `stock` keeps only stocks, `etf` only ETFs, `all` (default) both. Money-market / short-bond ETFs dominate `sort=amount` unless you pass `stock`. Filtered before sort / limit; every row carries `security_type` either way.

sort.description: Server-side ranking key, applied before `limit`; omit for `canonical_code` order. `margin_balance` / `margin_net_buy` turn `include_margin` on. Null sort values land last in both directions.

trade_date.description: Past trading day (YYYY-MM-DD) to scan instead of the live snapshot — rows are that day's daily bars. Only `price` / `pct_change` / `amount` / `turnover_rate` / `canonical_code` sort historically; `concept_id`, `include_margin` and `margin_target` cannot be combined. Today / future / non-trading days are rejected.

name: scan
